about_the_game:
Nippon Island is a first-person story-driven adventure that begins aboard a quiet flight to Japan. You play as a silent traveler, joined by your partner Machiko. Everything feels normal—until it doesn’t.

At first, you explore the plane, find your seat, chat with passengers, enjoy a coffee. But soon, reality starts to shift. Sounds change. Time feels strange. Memories surface. The calm routine slips into something surreal—and deeply personal.

This is only the first chapter of a much longer journey through Japan, where the line between reality and imagination continues to blur. As you go deeper, someone—or something—is watching. And one cat begins to care.

Key Features

  • 🛩️ First-person narrative adventure with immersive atmosphere

  • 👥 Interactive NPCs: engage with fellow passengers, including your partner Machiko

  • ☕ Peaceful, slice-of-life moments: drink coffee, look out the window, enjoy small details

  • 🌫️ Subtle descent into surrealism: watch as the ordinary turns uncanny

  • 🧩 A layered mystery tied to identity, memory, and control

  • 🐈 And much more...

Whether you're drawn to quiet storytelling, emotional journeys, or the mysteries of travel, Nippon Island invites you to begin an unforgettable trip.

The flight is only the beginning.
Welcome aboard.
